name: Harbour Hall, rack 14
blurb: A leased rack in a harbour data hall. Yours, under another name.
banner: Tenant console. Remote hands on request.
Power: A+B feeds nominal. Door last opened: never.

content.text:
SUNDHÖFN COLOCATION
Lease, hall 2, rack 14.

Tenant: Northlight Marine Survey ehf.
Term: rolling, paid twelve months ahead.
Contact: none given. Invoices to the post box.

Note from the front desk: nobody from Northlight has ever visited. The rack was built by a courier with a pallet and a diagram.

REMOTE HANDS, rack 14

03 Feb  Pallet received. Built to tenant's diagram. Tenant not present.
11 Feb  Tenant asked by post for the blanking plates to be left off. Done.
02 Mar  Hall 2 audit. Rack 14 skipped at the tenant's request. Fee paid.
19 Apr  Engineer reports the rack draws power and passes traffic and has never once been logged in to from this building.
